title: Results of the Year's Working
caption_extra: INDUSTRIAL UNDERTAKINGS. The results of the year's working are given below:—

title: Ordinary Income and Expenditure, 1911 and 1912
caption_extra: CONCLUSION. It is very satisfactory to be able to record the fact that, during the year under review, the growth of Ordinary Expenditure has been more than counterbalanced by the increase in Ordinary Income, the* actual figures being as under:—
